note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; statuses are shown as supplied and no consequence is inferred.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional intake: a person walks to the registry window, hands in three tabbed sheets, the clerk checks each against the supplied checklist (all received as supplied), prints an entry-reference slip and hands it back.

presets.description: Substantive alternative: four supplied items, the third supplied as pending — only three sheets are in the bundle, the clerk marks that row with a dashed empty ring, and the slip is still printed and handed back as supplied. Different people and speech.
